positive.prompt: How do I install a local preview version of the .NET SDK?
Create a global.json file to lock our .NET SDK version locally
Write a script to install .NET SDK preview workloads on my local machine

evals.prompt: Following SDK.md, pin this repository's .NET SDK with a global.json and set up a repository-local preview SDK without touching the system-wide installation.
evals.expected_output: global.json locks SDK version locally without affecting systems global configuration.
expectations: global.json is valid JSON that pins the 8.0.4xx band (version plus a rollForward policy such as latestPatch)
The preview SDK is installed or scripted into ./.dotnet using the dotnet-install script with an install-dir, not a system installer
PATH or DOTNET_ROOT routing for the local SDK is configured or documented and verified with dotnet --info or --list-sdks
Nothing is installed or changed in the system-wide dotnet location
